properties.name: Lake Ontario and the upper Saint Lawrence through Brockville
properties.processing: Source water polygons joined and unioned; original island holes retained. No channel connections fabricated.
properties.backgroundExtension: Actual OpenStreetMap maritime water polygons via OpenFreeMap, extended beyond 65.7W / 50.8N to avoid a visible source-tile cutoff at the artwork edge. No change to currents.
properties.displaySelection: Source polygon components selected for the Lake Ontario close-up; original vertices and island rings unchanged. Renderer clips the view east of Brockville.
properties.repair: Alexandria Bay water restored from original OpenFreeMap water polygons; island holes retained.
properties.framing: Lake and main-river components, cropped at the Brockville model outlet cross-section.
